Maria: quick thread suppression preview a11y pass. figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz Kevin: main items: keyboard nav, SR announcements, contrast, and concise copy. Jess: repro: focus trap on channel chips when tabbing. Chrome+VoiceOver. Oliver: root cause: chips inside focusable div. fix by rendering `ul > li > button.chip` and use `aria-pressed`. Anya: quick a11y checklist: 1) aria-live for toggle, 2) focus-visible 3px, 3) chip contrast >=4.5:1, 4) title/aria-label for truncated names. Kevin: copy tweak: change toggle text to 'Show suppression preview' and header to 'Preview: 3 channels will be suppressed'. Jess: small snippet for SR announcement:
Preview enabled: 3 channels muted
Maria: can we get a PR by EOW? Oliver: opening PR now. design-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pull/421 Anya: I'll run VoiceOver on staging once merged. Maria: thanks team, assigning follow-ups: @Jess DOM + focus, @Oliver aria attrs, @Kevin copy. ping when ready.
